questions.question: Initial selection
questions.answer_scope: Pinned ranked-file prefix, per-device K24 filtering, sequential fill, aligned byte cap stops prefix; profile creation provenance remains unknown.

questions.question: Initial identities by device
questions.answer_scope: Generation 0 intervals and sortable per-layer initial table; exact physical device/class capacity.

questions.question: Early usefulness
questions.answer_scope: Demanded identity and actual-service-before-eviction curves at W1/4/16/64/256/full; not hit percentages.

questions.question: Startup replacement speed
questions.answer_scope: Uninterrupted generation survival, initial-identity return and cumulative replacement.

questions.question: Initial churn burst
questions.answer_scope: Raw/rolling admissions and layer turnover; no universal burst assumed.

questions.question: Admissions and evictions over time
questions.answer_scope: Raw and cumulative counts/payload; spare withdrawal distinct.

questions.question: Churn stabilization
questions.answer_scope: Zoomed late windows and rolling counts; no arbitrary stability claim.

questions.question: Layers/classes with churn
questions.answer_scope: All-layer turnover and class-aware capacities/traffic.

questions.question: Repeated reloads
questions.answer_scope: Distinct generation IDs, previous generation and actual service.

questions.question: Long residency with little use
questions.answer_scope: Lifetime-use scatter and longest idle interval; finite-end censoring explicit.

questions.question: Short useful bursts
questions.answer_scope: First-use delay, short observed lifetime and use count.

questions.question: Nonresident work over time
questions.answer_scope: Required CPU/mapped and unknown modeled nonlocal entries.

questions.question: VRAM/CPU/mapped by stage
questions.answer_scope: Common-denominator lane counts or shares; MTP subdivision unavailable.

questions.question: Current versus future-informed
questions.answer_scope: Exact tape/trace identity, linked overlays and 44 within-source whole-model set comparisons.

questions.question: Oracle churn versus victim quality
questions.answer_scope: Distinct feasible/timing-relaxed semantics, observed useful copy partitions and service; no optimality claim.

questions.question: Closest future set
questions.answer_scope: Per-source reference Jaccard ranking; not a cross-domain winner or utility metric.

questions.question: AUC to outcome loss
questions.answer_scope: 48 empirical ROC curves, retained calibration, unit-labeled funnel, first-use waste, guard and original paired TG.

questions.question: First-use TC change
questions.answer_scope: Retained development OFF/ON, Phase 1/2 generations and matched history/logistic; different campaigns not new causal timing.

questions.question: Reuse versus lifetime
questions.answer_scope: Logical reuse/idle/return distributions; host copy bracket separate from DMA-only cost.

questions.question: Lease design evidence
questions.answer_scope: Exploratory thresholds and per-expert demand; no clusters or optimal TTL asserted.

questions.question: Do-not-admit / short / long / pinned candidates
questions.answer_scope: Exploratory count labels, censoring and competing-demand warnings; not ground-truth allocation categories.

evidence: Browser validation of all ten pages plus data/provenance reconciliation; no fabricated missing events.
